chapter: Follow-up questions, Bird and the Ellington sidemen
title: Meeting Dizzy in Chicago at the Savoy Ballroom
summary: Jones first met Dizzy around 1941 at the Chicago Savoy and contrasts that distance with New York.

story.theme_name: Charlie Parker, Dizzy and the bebop revolution
story.community_name: Charlie Parker: encounters, lore and legacy

blocks.x: When did you first meet Dizzy?
Oh, let's see. In the early '40s, about maybe '41. I guess around there somewhere.
That would have been in Chicago, right?
Yes, it was in Chicago. He was playing with Cab at that point, I think.

And well, he was -- it was a dance that -- they had a Savoy in Chicago too, a Savoy Ballroom, and it was right near the Regal Theater, and all the big bands used to come there and play. And local musicians. We'd all go to catch our favorites, you know, because that was the only way we could ever get close to the guys, because they were basically from back east, you know?

And we just wanted to get a chance to meet them, you know? And when Ellington used to come there we'd do the same thing. When I went to New York it was so different in that everybody was -- you're rubbing elbows with everybody, you know?
That's the reason, when I first went to New York, I said, 'I'm not going back to Chicago, ever.'
I fell in love with New York as soon as I got there.
